meta.title: Heads of state and effective national leaders, 1900–2026
meta.scope: Initial research staging cohort for the states and successor regimes explicitly requested in MSG-095. Includes key heads of state and effective national leaders; it is not an exhaustive roster of every prime minister, cabinet, party secretary or acting office-holder in all 16 country families.
meta.dateConvention: ISO-8601 Gregorian. Dates are exact where official chronologies provide them; some ranges use day precision inferred from year-level institutional lists and are marked supported or flagged in notes. Open terms end at snapshotDate.

roles.head_of_state: Constitutional or de jure head of state.
roles.effective_leader: Person exercising effective national executive/party authority; may overlap with head_of_state.

qualityLegend.verified: Official government, constitutional, parliamentary, archival or institutional source directly confirms office/term.
qualityLegend.supported: Institutional historical synthesis or official chronology supports the entry; day-level boundaries may require validation.
qualityLegend.unverified: Not used as a positive production assertion; gaps are listed.

meta.schemaNote: Research staging only. This schema is richer than historical_data/leaders/heads_of_state.json and does not replace it. Entity IDs are provisional research keys; check political_entities/registry.json before integration. Duplicate names across role records are intentional when one person held separate formal and effective offices. A person with discontinuous terms has separate records.
meta.integrationWarning: Do not import this cohort as deterministic forced succession without checking simulated regime, entity identity, office existence, and historical continuity. For parliamentary systems the Prime Minister is effective_leader while monarch/president is head_of_state. For one-party states party leader is effective_leader; formal chairman/president is separately recorded.

cg43b.scope: MSG-097 supplement: Beiyang ROC 1916–1928; Second Spanish Republic; Weimar chancellors; FRG presidents; GDR heads of state, ministers-president and SED leader; Japanese wartime prime ministers; CPV General Secretaries; DRV/Vietnam governments; State of Vietnam; Republic of Vietnam; PRG.
cg43b.datePrecision: Records with date_precision month/year use normalized ISO date boundaries where the source only gives month/year. Do not interpret normalized day as a verified inauguration day. Secondary chronology is explicitly marked supported and requires primary archive confirmation before production.
